Class ManagerApp

java.lang.Object
frontend.ManagerApp
public class ManagerApp extends Object
Manager interface for reporting and back-office CRUD operations.

Features include:

  • Reports: Sales by day, Sales by item, Product use, Restock, X/Z reports
  • CRUD: Menu items, Inventory, Employees (soft delete)
  • Inline Availability toggles via table checkboxes
Access is granted from CashierApp when the user has a manager or admin role.
